name: 34638 · Land O Lakes, FL
findings: ZIP 34638 (Land O Lakes) has 65 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34638 (Land O Lakes) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 34638 (Land O Lakes) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
